limits: Exact directEnemy source snowmanB, CEL enSnowmanB(Clone), motion renderer SnowMan_Geo/enSnowmanmiddleBody and source renderer 121697 only. The same runtime profile binds four companion custom renderers, but this archive grants canonical route credit only to the selected middle-body renderer.

The ordinary zero-focus attack used the native bluntSmithHammer without a skill cap or damage fixture and produced native Damaged for 8 HP, from 58 to 50. The disposable party maximum-HP fortification remained active for test survival and is not representative hero balance.
The explicit KillSingle fixture reduced HP from 50 to 0 with recorded native 1000 damage and a Death trigger. It is fixture death evidence, not ordinary lethal gameplay.
The source has m_DoRagdoll false and zero rigidbodies. Torso, arm and hand separation with the upper assembly is native snowman_damage and snowman_deathDirect animation, not ragdoll evidence.

All three captures retain the requested 120 frames. The exact middle-body renderer remains active, enabled, reported visible and identity-stable through every retained frame. Later smoke, distance, camera and loot occlusion do not establish a readable corpse, exact collision, later corpse lifetime, cleanup causality or final disposal.
Two guarded native Collect actions succeeded and strict Ready succeeded at level 0, room 2, with one button.

Seventeen selected original PNGs were reviewed. Native effects, combat UI, foreground hero overlap, smoke, motion blur, camera framing and the loot panel limit fine inspection in stated frames; the remaining 343 capture PNGs were preserved by hash but not individually reviewed.

This isolated dungeon trial does not prove every snowman animation, collision, culling boundaries, portrait framing, alternate materials, long-session resource lifetime, inheritance to another snowman source, the four companion renderer topologies or finished-art acceptance.
